dedupe_keys.name: numerical models for 1d and 2d instantaneous dam breaks

description: Numerical Models for 1D and 2D Instantaneous Dam-Breaks is a model listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by BALACHANDRAN, SHIVAKUMAR (deposited on HydroShare). The dam-break models for instantaneous failures for 1D and 2D flows are developed by solving Saint-Venant Equations using a second-order explicit numerical scheme. The 1D codes are specifically developed for validation purposes. The 1D numerical scheme is used to generate 15,173 different scenarios for the development of scale-invariant ML models. Coverage: not restricted to one place in the metadata. The resource was created 2025-07-09 and last updated 2025-11-28; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the resource metadata. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
